derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G739 (ἄρτιος);
def: to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher)

occurrences.text: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
